In our clientsâ words
About us
A trusted manufacturing partner to todayâs most forward-thinking jewelry brands â built on experience, integrity, and relentless attention to detail.
Our story
Founded in 2017, Petra Jewelry emerged from a shared vision to bridge the gap between creative brands and expert manufacturing. With decades of combined experienceâspanning global brand-building and high-volume production for industry leadersâwe crafted a factory that marries design innovation with technical precision.
Trusted by brands like Asos, Guess, and Nordstrom, we specialize in crafting fashion jewelry from premium materials, including sterling silver and stainless steel, and boast one of the regionâs largest chain-making facilities.
Meet the people behind Petra
- 01 Full vertical integration Design, casting, setting, plating, QC, and fulfillment
- 02 On-ground team WesternâChinese leadership with strong factory ties
- 03 Transparency-first Clear pricing, real timelines, and open communication
- 04 Scalable support From small runs to mass-market rollouts
Our hybrid leadership structure means youâre getting the best of both worlds â international quality standards with the speed and cost-efficiency of Chinese manufacturing.

We offer full-spectrum services for brands who want things done right the first time.
Core services
- Product Development CAD design, sampling, material sourcing
- Casting Brass, sterling silver, stainless steel
- Stone Setting CZ, lab-grown, natural â prong, pave, bezel
- Plating & Finishing Gold vermeil, IP plating, rhodium, matte/polish
- Packaging Solutions Custom boxes, eco-mailers, gift kits
- Logistics & Fulfillment Assembly, QC, labeling, global shipping
Our minimum order quantity (MOQ) is 200 units. This ensures efficient production and cost-effectiveness for both small and large orders.
Yes. Our contract manufacturing process is IP-safe and NDA-protected, so your designs stay yours from the first sketch to the final shipment.
Yes. Sampling is part of our CAD-to-sample process, so you can approve the piece before you commit to a full production run.
It depends on the design, materials and quantity. We confirm a clear timeline with every quote and keep you updated at each stage.
Yes. We offer custom boxes, eco-mailers and gift kits, plus assembly, labeling and global shipping.
We take your custom designs and turn them into high-quality, production-ready jewelry â with full control over materials, processes, and details.
Start your project
Our process
- Start with your concept and goals â we listen, understand, and collaborate on your vision.
- From CAD modeling to material selection, we plan every detail with precision and purpose.
- Skilled artisans and advanced tools come together to build your custom solution with care.
- Thorough inspection and testing to ensure stability, quality, and reliability.
Six core capabilities.
One considered process.
Bespoke jewelry crafted with premium materials and innovative design, reflecting exclusivity and prestige.
Private label and exclusive collections built to your price points, with the consistency and certified production big retailers expect.
Reliable, repeatable production at volume â from small runs to mass-market rollouts.
At Petra Jewelry, sustainability isnât an afterthoughtâitâs part of who we are. As a trusted manufacturing partner to leading global brands, we believe that beautiful jewelry should be made with integrity and respect for the planet.
Our approach
- FSC Packaging
- Recycled Metals
- Ethical Sourcing
Our approach
Ethical Sourcing
We work only with vetted suppliers who meet strict ethical and environmental standardsâensuring our metals, stones, and materials are responsibly sourced.
Eco-Conscious Manufacturing
Our fully integrated production process allows us to minimize waste and energy use at every stageâfrom design and casting to finishing and fulfillment.
Waste Management & Recycling
We recycle precious metals, reuse materials, and responsibly dispose of manufacturing byproducts.
Continuous
Improvement
We know sustainability is a journey, not a destination. Thatâs why we regularly review and refine our processes, working closely with our partners to raise the bar on responsibility and transparency across the supply chain. From ethically sourced materials to reducing waste in production, every step we take is intentional.
Our goal is not only to meet global standards but to lead by example in building a more responsible jewelry industry.
A Better Future, Together
Weâre proud to help global brands bring their jewelry to life â beautifully, ethically, and responsibly. When you partner with Petra Jewelry, youâre not just choosing a manufacturer. Youâre choosing to make a positive impact. We prioritize sustainable materials, energy-efficient production, and fair labor practices.
Together, we can create timeless pieces that respect both people and the planet.
Contact us
A trusted manufacturing partner to todayâs most forward-thinking jewelry brands â built on experience, integrity, and relentless attention to detail.
Request for catalogue
We respond within 24 hours.
A name behind every piece.
Every promise has a face.
Meet the people you would work with. Western and Chinese leadership, united by one standard: standing behind your product.
We started on your side of the table.
We were jewelry designers and brand builders, sending files into a black box and waiting to see what came back.
Beautiful work arrived too slowly. Faster production fell short. Middlemen stood between the brand and the people making it.
So we built a different kind of partner.
One team. One standard.
From the master you sign
to the carton we seal.
We know what it means to trust someone with an idea.
We began as jewelry designers and brand builders. Your point of view is where our story started.
The same bar for every piece, no matter who signs it off.
Western and Chinese leadership share one quality standard. A sample passes or it goes back, and you hear about it either way.
Your project has a name, a desk, and a phone number.
No agents, no middlemen. You work directly with the people in Shenzhen and Dongguan who design, make, and ship your product.
